All six children closed. Success Criteria verified against merged code:

1. MET — no git2 type is named outside src/vcs/git/. The five remaining mentions (vcs/mod.rs, vcs/discover.rs, vcs/repo.rs) are all doc comments explaining the boundary.
2. MET — the UI holds only domain types: WorktreesComponent stores Vec of SpaceEntry (Space plus its repo's display name), RepositoriesComponent stores Vec of BoxedVcs. grep finds no GitBackend, JjBackend or git2 in app.rs or components/.
3. PARTLY MET — 'implementing one trait and touching nothing else' is not literally true. A third backend needs a Backend variant plus arms in backend.rs (name, space_noun), detection in discover.rs, and the dispatch in vcs::open. That is one trait plus four small, obvious sites, all of which the compiler points at via exhaustive matches — much better than before, but not zero. Recorded honestly rather than rounded up.
